warning: Repeated finite development checklist, not medical accuracy. Clinical trials use frozen reviewed rosters; alternate schema representations can produce pattern misses. Nonvalid error counters can overlap. Throughput includes retries and all completion tokens, excludes startup.

manual_audit.finding: Initial Na/K values 129/7.4, 115/6.4, 121/6.3 mmol/L stay with infants p1/p2/p3 across all six trials. Flucloxacillin appears in every trial, but route is null in three while IV remains in the name.

Drain fluid creatinine 0.27 mg/dL is present in all first passes and only three final observations sections. In whole seeds 42/43 correcting an unsupported time to null was rejected as field erasure. Compact seed44 retained incorrect time/evidence association after repair.
All six retain the initial no-metastasis imaging in observations despite the conditions-only checklist missing it. Subsequent metastasis must remain a different event.
NRAS Q61R and VAF 30% survive in observations across all six; failing oncology bundles are not complete disappearance of this fact from the patient record.

Negative Doppler findings and acemetacin dose/frequency are supported in inspected outputs. Discovery seed43 adds two explicitly prior-publication patients; this is a primary-versus-cited scope issue, not invented identities.
A source-negative bone involvement result can miss the gold pattern because assertion absent represents the same negative finding that the gold expected as a present observation.
Valid description invents skin-barrier-to-GI direction and a GI-to-atopy loop, and misplaces a dashed connection to hyponatraemia. Correct broad background scope does not validate arrow connectivity.
Valid PET panel C description confuses PSMA/FDG/DOTATATE/FAPI labels. All-panels-PET/CT claim overlooks grayscale PET MIPs in A and standalone grayscale CT views in F.

CoMET pixel descriptions are valid only in whole seeds43/44. Seed43 whole correctly reads bed/INST numbers in prose but leaves chart readings empty and clinical-chart flag false; categorical definition/structured extraction needs refinement. Aggregate dashboard should not be assigned to the illustrative index infant.
